The data from the biometric assessment were linked to the BVN of the employees and pensioners. The biometric capture exercise was also updated in 2019 and it is estimated that about 95 of employees and pensioners have been captured. The remaining 5 are mainly pensioners and newly employed personnel.Commitment controls in Yobe State seem to be effective limit commitments to approved budget allocations including budget revisions for most types of expenditure and actual cash available.The 2019 audit report shows that the control of expenditure during the period appeared to be reasonably satisfactory. comment.narrative: Yobe State began the implementation of the National Chart of Accounts NCoA in 2014. From the fiscal year 2014 to 2019 budget and accounting reports were prepared using the IPSAS cash basis accounting. Only five of the six NCoA segments has been developed i.e. the administrative economic functional fund and geographical segments. The programme segment is yet to be developed. The budget classification and chart of accounts used to prepare the budget and other financial reports largely reflect the goals of YOSERA. The 2020 budget was prepared on accrual basis accounting and it is planned to prepare the 2020 financial statements using the accrual basis accounting standard.
